title: A DEMO RUN SAVES ITS RUN REPORT
why: His answer 66 (save each party run report) and 2.92 (the game logs everything automatically). A finished demo run wrote nothing, so stutter on the two TVs left no numbers. Each window now posts its run report, tagged demo and seat p1 or p2, to the local collector after the RUN OVER card is up. No Downloads file, no banner, nothing off localhost.
now: Every finished demo run posts its report (with the gfx p50 p95 slow line) to the local collector from both windows.
